title: TERMINAL 02
description:
This is a sequel to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3088099655]Terminal Wallpaper[/url].

[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Clock and date display
[*] Minute / hour / day / week / month / year progress indicators
[*] Sunrise and sunset times based on latitude and longitude
[*] [url=https://github.com/sheetau/PerformanceMonitor/releases/latest]Performance Monitor[/url] with fully customizable layout (via performance.layout.js in project folder)
[*] Currently playing music information
[*] Two configurable world clocks
[*] Weather information based on latitude and longitude
[*] Monitor and cursor information display
[*] System log display
[*] Full customization support: fonts, font size, margins, opacity, colors, filters, and more
[*] Hidden stopwatch mode by clicking the time box (double-click to exit)
[*] Supports any screen resolution and aspect ratio
[/list]

For information or inquiries about the performance monitor, please visit:
[url=https://github.com/sheetau/PerformanceMonitor]https://github.com/sheetau/PerformanceMonitor[/url]

Try disabling filters if the wallpaper is affecting your PC's performance.

made with HTML, CSS, Javascript.
